title: Handball at Beit Maccabi
keys: Arrows / WASD: run · Space: pass · Enter / K: shoot · Q: switch player · Esc: quit
how: Four court players and a keeper a side. Stay out of the blue area. A shot goes where the yellow marker on the goal is. On a phone: tap the court to run, a team-mate to pass, the goal to shoot.
golden: A draw! Golden goal: the next goal wins
lineWin: Beit Maccabi is on its feet
lineRetry: Ilan is waiting for a rematch
